rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a boss or person in charge.

example.english: My boss told me to come to work early today.
example.traditional: 我個老細今日叫我早啲返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 giu3 ngo5 zou2 di1 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this especially for a business owner, employer, or shopkeeper rather than any workplace supervisor.

example.english: The boss of this shop is very kind.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭嘅老闆好好人。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 ge3 lou5 baan2 hou2 hou2 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a supervisor or manager in an organizational or workplace context.

example.english: Our boss asked us to hand in a report next week.
example.traditional: 我哋主管叫我哋下個禮拜交份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zyu2 gun2 giu3 ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: In gaming talk, this refers to the powerful enemy or final boss that must be defeated.

example.english: The boss in this level is really hard to beat.
example.traditional: 呢關個大佬真係好難打。
example.jyutping: ni1 gwaan1 go3 daai6 lou2 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 daa2
